review_items.rationale: Review of fixed artifact 83b99221f457497c9690fb8c13a0d793 and run c95ee11a6a44469f8e7db1a75f3aafb4 covers claim-async-append-dependency v1 and both v1 bindings. The public async interface makes top-level Ready messages immediately deliverable but requires ordered append work and durable completion before attached responses. The driver starts from a shared compacted snapshot via public storage APIs, actually campaigns node 1, drains vote/append storage and response traffic, proposes the payload and captures the resulting MsgApp(index 3, entry term/message term 2, predecessor 2). It redelivers those exact bytes while node 2 original append work is withheld; no critical raft state is assigned. Same-worker work is then completed in Ready order. There are no timer firings during this finite schedule; omitted ticks neither supply nor invalidate the measured storage dependency. The corrected stored helper first reads LastIndex, so absent index 3 can be observed safely; the new stored_before_ready=false antecedent is logically identical to the original pending=true condition. Identity fields correlate scenario/phase/endpoints/entry/message context across produced, admitted and completed; the explicit producer_term reference establishes producer-before-admission. Phase distinguishes deliveries rather than inventing separate entries. All three admissions and independent completed events occurred. Original and duplicate report stored_before_ready=false and direct_acks=0; the duplicate reports append_entries=0, append_work_count=1 and nested_acks=1. Each ack_published reports stored=true; each completed reports one published acknowledgment and exact entry stored at end. The stored_retry control begins with storage already present. No completion-gap event or nonzero exit occurred. The schedule publishes top-level messages before executing delayed local work even if the oracle would fail, so it does not assume the safety property. The primary implication is one-way and does not require acknowledgments before persistence or infer progress from a pending state. A bounded holds interpretation is supported; source protections (msgsAfterAppend and response-only needStorageAppendMsg) explain it without claiming wider agreement or crash durability.
